items.title: 18.7.2 Cobalt(II) complexes ke ligand exchange reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the ligand exchange reactions of cobalt(II) (PDF 28-29).

blocks.text: Cobalt(II) ke namak bhi paani mein complex ions banate hain: Co2+(aq) ka matlab [Co(H2O)6]2+ hai, jo cobalt(II) sulphate ke mehlool ko gulabi rang deta hai.

blocks.caption: Cobalt(II) ke ligand exchange reactions
rows: gulabi mehlool se neela precipitate, jo pare pare gulabi ho sakta hai
ghulne wala hexaamminecobalt(II) ion; peela mehlool
paani ke ligands seedhe ammonia se badalte

blocks.alt: Baen se daen chaar test tubes: [Co(H2O)6]2+ ka gulabi mehlool; NaOH solution ke baad [Co(H2O)4(OH)2] ka neela precipitate; pare rehne par gulabi precipitate; zaid ammonia se [Co(NH3)6]2+ ka peela-bhoora mehlool.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.9: Hydroxide aur NH3 daalne par [Co(H2O)6]2+ mein rang ki tabdeeliyan (kitab ki Figure 18.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure aakhri formula [Co(NH3)6]^2 chhaapti hai; charge 2+ hai, is liye khaake mein [Co(NH3)6]2+ likha hai. Pehle OH- do H2O ki jagah le kar neela cobalt(II) hydroxide bithate hain jo pare pare gulabi ho sakta hai. Zaid ammonia mein chhe NH3 sab ligands ki jagah le kar ghulne wala peela hexaamminecobalt(II) ion banate hain.

blocks.alt: Do test tubes: [Co(H2O)6]2+ ka gulabi mehlool conc. HCl daalne se [CoCl4]2- ka neela mehlool ban jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.10: Co(II) complex mein paani ke molecules ki jagah chloride ions (kitab ki Figure 18.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaar Cl- chhe H2O ki jagah lete hain. Gulabi [Co(H2O)6]2+ octahedral (6 ligands) hai aur neela [CoCl4]2- tetrahedral (4 ligands); shakal aur ligand badalne se Delta E badalta hai aur rang gulabi se neela ho jata hai. Paani daalne se yeh tabdeeli wapas ho jati hai.
Paani wale cobalt(II) ions aam taur par Cl-, OH- aur SCN- jaise monodentate anionic ligands ke saath tetrahedral complexes banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Cobalt(II) mehlool mein conc. HCl milane par rang mein kya tabdeeli aati hai, aur kaun sa ion banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Gulabi se neela, kyunke tetrahedral [CoCl4]2- banta hai.

items: Zaid NH3 se peela [Co(NH3)6]2+; conc. HCl se neela [CoCl4]2-.
